mechanism: Place one original clearly adult protagonist at a measurable disadvantage inside a ring of adult opponents. The recovery must progress through four distinct but materially continuous ability states: a grounded positional escape, a compact guard that visibly deforms under one close hit, a focused counter that uses the retained material, and one floor-bound radial release that moves opponents outward. Preserve the same water, light, dust or other medium between stages and keep bodies readable through every effect. End on a quiet center-versus-ring tableau. The reusable mechanism is disadvantage baseline, grounded recovery, deforming guard, retained-material counter, radial clearing proof and calm center—not the source school setting, youthful styling, people, uniforms, water design, exact choreography, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Use clearly adult original characters in a non-school setting and establish a measurable center-versus-ring disadvantage.
invariants.purpose: Removes ambiguous age and makes the reversal spatially legible.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without adult identity and group geometry, the sequence becomes unsafe or abstract.

invariants.rule: Begin recovery with one grounded positional action before any large ability.
invariants.purpose: Gives the protagonist earned space and a physical first step.
invariants.ablation_failure: Immediate spectacle skips the disadvantage-to-agency transition.

invariants.rule: Make one compact guard visibly deform under a close committed hit while both bodies remain readable.
invariants.purpose: Proves defense rather than decorative shielding.
invariants.ablation_failure: An opaque bubble hides contact and consequence.

invariants.rule: Reuse the same retained medium for the focused counter and radial release.
invariants.purpose: Creates material continuity across ability stages.
invariants.ablation_failure: Fresh unrelated effects feel like a disconnected power reel.

invariants.rule: End with opponents displaced outward and the same adult calm at the unchanged center.
invariants.purpose: Provides geometric proof of the clear.
invariants.ablation_failure: A close-up ending cannot verify the radial result.

slots.name: setting

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

source camera, timing, creator identity and Seedance 2.5 prompt wording
